scope_limits: This is a conditional 73-letter structural simplicity statistic, not a full 97-letter-key MDL or a natural-language-key recognizer.
Approximate residual scores do not resurrect crib-excluded exact models; exact diagnostics and all winner residual positions must be retained.
Lengths 1 through 32 were selected before current scoring with prior crib-only compatibility knowledge; authors remain blinded, but the entire design is not historically target-naive.
Matched validation flags share calibration sets and a fixed bank; no independent-binomial confidence or universal false-positive claim is justified.
Running-key and bank-absent controls have limited, explicitly documented scope; a pilot failure does not reject all plausible natural-language running keys.
Controls must run under the frozen manifest and pass all gates; only the parent may separately authorize any canonical K4 acceptance/scoring afterward.

test_evidence.scoring_inputs: synthetic random 32-message bank only; no real-bank controls or K4 scored

verified: All 32 bank messages match retained author normalized strings, are unique, have length 97, and meet both exact crib positions.
Primary maximum evaluates all 32 candidates and 1152 registered descriptions using lengths 1 through 32, with the registered candidate/model/seed/noncrib-residual costs.
Optimized bitmask/autokey and periodic scorer matches exhaustive reference on a synthetic bank; hand vectors, all-tableau randomized roundtrips, and boundary planted recovery pass.
Frozen 84 controls reproduce exactly: 36 simple, 24 length-29 hard, 12 running-key diagnostics, and 12 bank-absent controls.
The 60 in-scope controls cover all 32 bank messages and include 30 thematic and 30 neutral targets; independently authored held-out message is absent from bank.
Conditional nulls preserve every crib ciphertext position and noncrib ciphertext multiset; all nulls use the full bank/model maximum and conservative >= Monte Carlo comparison.
Control gates enforce registered recovery thresholds and complete denominators; bank-absent validation flags remain separate from the 600 in-scope null denominator.
Freeze creation rejects missing/failed audits and changed audited source hashes; manifest includes raw author artifacts, control definitions, code, configuration, and audit.
Explicit planted/recovered tableau, structure, seed, and full-key label comparisons do not misidentify equal scores as proof of model equivalence.
No network code, external model dependency, K4 retrieval, or automatic control-to-K4 transition is present.
